ISRAEL (THE NORTH): 19 RULERS JEROBOAM I → HOSHEA
At Horeb Elijah was told: “Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel”. 1 Kings 19:16
Elisha sent one of the sons of the prophets to Ramoth-gilead with a box of oil; he anointed Jehu in an inner room and fled. 2 Kings 9:1–10
The captains spread their garments under him on the stairs, blew trumpets and said “Jehu is king”; then “Jehu ... conspired against Joram”. 2 Kings 9:13–14
“Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart”
“from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them”
The LORD's word to him: “thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes ... thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel”. 2 Kings 10:30
But “he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam”: the golden calves at Beth-el and Dan stayed. 2 Kings 10:29 2 Kings 10:31
Hosea, in a later reign: “I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu”. Hosea 1:4
Kings notes the promise kept when his great-great-grandson Zechariah was killed: “And so it came to pass.” 2 Kings 15:12

“Son of Omri” as a dynastic label
Luckenbill translates the phrase “Jehu, son of Omri” (Assyrian mar Humri); Assyrian texts also call Israel “Humri”, so the phrase names the realm, not Jehu's father.[4][6]
R. W. Rogers (1912), p. 304, note 2, following Bezold
Rogers translates “Jehu, of the land of Omri” and notes that mar Humri, “formerly translated ‘son of Omri,’ means rather ‘the people of the land of Omri’”.[14]

1 Kings 19:15–17 2 Kings 9:1–37 2 Kings 10:1–36 2 Kings 15:12 2 Chronicles 22:7–9 Hosea 1:4
Kings does not mention any tribute from Jehu to Assyria; that is known from Shalmaneser's records.
Kings gives no cross-date for Jehu's own accession; the dating comes from Judah's Jehoash, who began “in the seventh year of Jehu” (2 Kings 12:1).
Scripture gives no age or mother's name for Jehu.
Called “Jehu the son of Nimshi” and “Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi”. 1 Kings 19:16 2 Kings 9:2
From the textNot the prophet Jehu son of Hanani (1 Kings 16:1), and his father Jehoshaphat is not Jehoshaphat king of Judah.
